cards.mood: The piece opens with a brooding, ominous atmosphere established by low strings and brass, creating a sense of impending dread.
cards.palette: A full string ensemble serves as the harmonic backbone throughout, starting with a rhythmic, staccato ostinato in the lower registers and expanding into sweeping, legato melodic lines during the climax.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The iron gates groan in the frozen mist
Shadows dance where the ancient stones rest
A crown of thorns upon a heavy brow
Silence is heavy, the world is hushed now
[Pre-Chorus]
One spark ignites the dying flame
The mountains bow and whisper his name
[Chorus]
Rise from the ashes, the spirit takes flight
A kingdom of silver in the pale moonlight
Through the thunder and the pouring rain
The heart finds glory, breaking every chain
[Verse]
Mountains of stone stand tall and gray
Whispers of giants fade into the day
Deep in the hollow, the secrets remain
Bound by the earth and the salt of the main
[Pre-Chorus]
One spark ignites the dying flame
The mountains bow and whisper his name
[Chorus]
Rise from the ashes, the spirit takes flight
A kingdom of silver in the pale moonlight
Through the thunder and the pouring rain
The heart finds glory, breaking every chain
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The walls are falling, the ground begins to shake
The sleeping giants of the valley now awake
[Chorus]
Rise from the ashes, the spirit takes flight
A kingdom of silver in the pale moonlight
Through the thunder and the pouring rain
The heart finds glory, breaking every chain
[Outro]
